activate.description: Bring Preview to the foreground without opening, importing, or selecting a document.

foreground-only.description: Foreground Preview without opening or importing a document.

prohibited: opening, importing, selecting, editing, annotating, signing, sharing, moving, or deleting a document
using a document picker or file-provider location
safety.uncertain_outcome: The launch may already have foregrounded Preview. Inspect only application foreground state; do not select a document or retry through a document picker.

host: Appium/XCUITest only for declared navigation controls
permissions: locally signed WebDriverAgent only for UI navigation

privacy.retention: The integration stores no document names, metadata, content, or annotations.
privacy.notes: This bundled manifest supports foreground-only launch. It makes no file-import, document-opening, or document-inspection support claim.
